responsibility: This file implements command-line style tokenization for arbitrary strings, not process argv, within the GNU Modula-2 mc-boot runtime. It scans a text command line into positional arguments, handling whitespace skipping, single-quoted and double-quoted regions, and backslash escapes, and exports routines to retrieve the nth parsed argument or count how many arguments the string contains.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the CmdArgs pair: unlike GCmdArgs.h, this file contains the tokenizer for command-line text strings, including whitespace skipping, quote handling, and backslash escape processing.
